_npc_system_info: Tests NPC spawns, de-escalation, escalation, and healing mechanics
_comment_initial_enemies: Start with low-morale enemies who can be intimidated/convinced to surrender
_comment_positions: Valid rings: Engaged, Near, Far, Extreme (no 'Medium')

initial_enemies.name: Freeborn Raiders
initial_enemies.spawn_reason: Cornered smugglers caught in contraband operation

_comment_initial_npcs: NPCs present at scenario start (can spawn via initial_npcs or DM can spawn via npc_spawns during play)

initial_npcs.name: Dock Worker Kassia
initial_npcs.description: Terrified civilian dock worker hiding behind cargo crates, caught in crossfire between raiders and enforcers

players.name: Negotiator Wei Lin
goals: Resolve conflicts through diplomacy when possible

scenario.situation: You've cornered a group of Freeborn raiders who were smuggling contraband. They're outgunned but not yet defeated. They might surrender if given the chance - or fight desperately if they feel trapped with no options. A civilian dock worker is hiding nearby, terrified of the crossfire.

scenario_hint: DM should spawn NPCs based on player actions: de-escalated enemies become wary/prisoner NPCs, the civilian can be convinced to help or may flee, wounded enemies can be stabilized via healing. Prisoners can provide intel via dialogue. If players attack surrendered NPCs, they should escalate back to enemies.

_test_notes.purpose: Test NPC system: spawns, de-escalation, escalation, healing, dialogue
expected_npc_triggers: Enemy surrender via intimidation → Deescalation (prisoner/wary disposition)
Civilian appears when combat calms → NPCSpawn (neutral disposition)
NPC dialogue with players → NPCLLMClient action declarations
Player attacks surrendered NPC → Escalation (NPC → enemy)
success_criteria: At least one enemy de-escalates to NPC (prisoner/wary)
Civilian NPC spawns and acts via LLM client
No keyword detection in conversion logic (structured output only)

verification.console_output: Look for DM narration about surrender/civilians
verification.jsonl: agent_conversion events with stable agent_id, healing_effect logs

mission_objectives.description: Capture at least one raider for interrogation
